scope: primary-source search for object prototype correspondence, pixel/query fusion, stable adaptation and visible-vs-amodal objectives

reading_level_definitions.official_code_checked: 已在V6设计中核官方实现，本轮沿用核验

retrieval_notes: CVF部分直接读取返回403；UNICL-SAM保留官方搜索摘要和元数据，未列为方法精读

sources.title: Learnable Shape Prototypes with Occlusion-Geometry-Guided Injection for Amodal Instance Segmentation
sources.venue_or_status: arXiv preprint; submitted to IEEE TCSVT, acceptance not verified
sources.paper_point: learnable shape memory + image cross-attention + SDF-guided spatial injection
sources.application: 借鉴按位置控制先验影响；直接相关的2026先例
sources.boundary: 目标是amodal；SDF外部也包含背景，不能直接当遮挡或可见Mask收益

sources.title: UNICL-SAM: Uncertainty-Driven In-Context Segmentation with Part Prototype Discovery
sources.checked_sections: official abstract / proceedings metadata; direct full-text access returned 403
sources.paper_point: uncertainty-aware examples and part prototype aggregation
sources.application: 支持局部原型和可靠性，反对只用全局均值
sources.boundary: few-shot/in-context场景；不证明原型对应真实身体部位

sources.title: Adaptive Prototype Learning and Allocation for Few-Shot Segmentation
sources.paper_point: superpixel clustering and per-pixel prototype allocation
sources.application: 原型需要覆盖局部外观变化并分配到具体像素
sources.boundary: 少样本语义分割；不能将其mIoU差值当猪群Mask AP预期

sources.title: PANet: Few-Shot Image Semantic Segmentation with Prototype Alignment
sources.paper_point: support/query prototype alignment
sources.application: 训练空间与查询空间要一致
sources.boundary: support/query循环不是带物理身份的表面对应监督

sources.title: DensePose: Dense Human Pose Estimation in the Wild
sources.paper_point: image pixels mapped to canonical body surface
sources.application: 把对象设计成可查询的身体表面，而非单个向量
sources.boundary: 人体标签与猪体不同；不能直接迁移其精度

sources.title: Continuous Surface Embeddings
sources.paper_point: learnable surface/pixel embeddings and geodesic-soft correspondence supervision
sources.application: 本轮首选：用合成表面ID监督像素到身体表面的映射
sources.boundary: 真实图无表面GT；合成到真实的对应可迁移性仍待检验

sources.title: Normalized Object Coordinate Space for Category-Level 6D Object Pose and Size Estimation
sources.paper_point: canonical coordinates + instance masks; context-aware mixed-reality data
sources.application: 合成数据导出规范坐标，与实例Mask一起训练
sources.boundary: RGB-D/尺度与刚体设定；不能声称仅RGB获得其6D姿态能力

sources.title: Animal Avatars: Reconstructing Animatable 3D Animals from Casual Videos
sources.checked_sections: author publication page and official repository README
sources.paper_point: SMAL model + dense CSE image-to-mesh constraints
sources.application: 几何对象与真实视觉对应一起使用，比单纯形状库更接近对象概念
sources.boundary: 主要为狗的视频重建，需多帧/相机等条件，不是实时猪群实例分割

sources.title: Conditional Convolutions for Instance Segmentation
sources.paper_point: instance-conditioned dynamic mask heads
sources.application: 融合需保留每个检测实例的查询与局部像素关系
sources.boundary: 动态权重本身不提供跨图像对象知识

sources.title: Segment Anything
sources.checked_sections: two-way transformer and mask_decoder.py, reviewed during V6 design
sources.paper_point: two-way token/image updates and token-conditioned mask readout
sources.application: 像素特征与实例查询共同解码
sources.boundary: 通用prompt分割不是对象原型；注意力权重不自动等于身体对应

sources.title: Segment Anything in High Quality
sources.paper_point: frozen pretrained SAM + HQ token + early/late/mask features + logit addition
sources.application: 借鉴保留预训练主路、在高分辨率私有特征上做条件修正
sources.boundary: SAM规模/数据/任务不同；冻结权重不保证所有原生输出函数都完全不变

sources.title: Masked-attention Mask Transformer for Universal Image Segmentation
sources.paper_point: mask-classification queries, multiscale pixel decoder and masked attention
sources.application: 实例查询必须通过有空间细节的像素解码器形成Mask
sources.boundary: 硬预测Mask可能屏蔽漏分区域，不建议直接照搬硬限制

sources.title: YOLACT: Real-time Instance Segmentation
sources.paper_point: per-image spatial prototypes multiplied by per-instance coefficients
sources.application: 明确原生P是每图空间基，跨图像对象库是另一个对象
sources.boundary: 原生P不能因名称prototype就被解释为持久身体对象

sources.title: Coarse-to-Fine Amodal Segmentation with Shape Prior
sources.paper_point: VQ mask-space coarse prior + image-conditioned convolutional refinement
sources.application: 粗对象形状需要当前图像高频细节修正
sources.boundary: amodal目标不同；VQ prior不是精确可见轮廓，也不是身体点语义

sources.title: PLUG: Revisiting Amodal Segmentation with Foundation Model and Hierarchical Focus
sources.paper_point: separate visible/occluded region branches and uncertainty-focused points
sources.application: 可见区域和遮挡补全的目标应分清
sources.boundary: 不把amodal扩张当可见Mask收益；未核实的会议信息不写成已录用

sources.title: BLADE: Box-Level Supervised Amodal Segmentation through Directed Expansion
sources.paper_point: box-supervised visible-to-amodal expansion
sources.application: 重叠/非重叠位置需要不同处理
sources.boundary: 其扩张目标与当前可见Mask评价不相同；不是AAAI 2025

sources.title: SuperGlue: Learning Feature Matching with Graph Neural Networks
sources.checked_sections: attention / optimal transport / unmatched dustbin method
sources.paper_point: contextual matching with explicit unmatched option
sources.application: 像素可拒绝错误身体对应，不能强迫背景/遮挡匹配
sources.boundary: 稀疏关键点近一对一；不可照搬成像素到表面的平衡一对一约束

sources.title: Explicit Inductive Bias for Transfer Learning with Convolutional Networks
sources.paper_point: regularization toward pretrained parameters rather than zero
sources.application: 若需解冻原生参数，应控制相对原起点的变化
sources.boundary: 分类迁移证据，不证明本轮下降由遗忘导致，也不保证Mask AP

sources.title: Fine-Tuning can Distort Pretrained Features and Underperform Out-of-Distribution
sources.paper_point: head alignment before full fine-tuning; linear-model OOD theory
sources.application: 先对齐新增接口，再考虑解冻，避免两者同时大幅漂移
sources.boundary: 其全特征FT/线性OOD假设不是当前头部微调任务，不能直接作根因证明

sources.title: Adding Conditional Control to Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
sources.paper_point: frozen backbone and zero-initialized conditional connections
sources.application: 初始化时精确回到预训练函数，逐步学习条件修正
sources.boundary: 扩散生成领域的工程先例，不能外推分割增益

sources.title: The Lovasz-Softmax Loss: A Tractable Surrogate for the Optimization of the Intersection-Over-Union Measure in Neural Networks
sources.paper_point: IoU-oriented surrogate and reduction distinctions
sources.application: 解释交叉熵下降与IoU/AP上升不是同一命题
sources.boundary: 本轮不据此临时更换loss，论文也不保证COCO AP

sources.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
sources.paper_point: frozen pretrained weights + trainable low-rank updates
sources.application: 把适配维持在较小子空间的参考
